title: upp/ingest — Request Parameters
description: Ingest events from text. Given a text, the server extracts relevant events and persists them. Events are immutable (event-sourcing). If a new event contradicts an existing one, the previous is marked as superseded.

entity_key.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns these events.

text.description: Text from which to extract events. The server analyzes this text, extracts relevant personal facts, and persists them.
